thesis: The episode discusses the recent announcement from Oxford University that a new malaria vaccine candidate is the first to achieve the World Health Organization's goal of 75% efficacy. The speakers highlight that this breakthrough represents nearly a century of research using traditional technology, contrasting it with the rapid mRNA development seen during the COVID pandemic, and note that malaria remains a significant global burden causing over 400,000 deaths annually, primarily in children under five in sub-Saharan Africa.
